claim.quote: Differential cross sections for the gamma p -> pi^0 p reaction have been measured with the A2 tagged-photon facilities at the Mainz Microtron, MAMI C, up to the center-of-mass energy W=1.9 GeV.

name: A2 measurement of pi0 photoproduction on the proton at MAMI C

summary.plain: A2 measured the differential cross sections of neutral-pion photoproduction on the proton up to a centre-of-mass energy of 1.9 GeV with unprecedented statistics and full angular coverage, increasing the world data on this reaction by about 47%.
summary.technical: Differential cross sections for gamma p -> pi0 p with the A2 tagged-photon facilities at MAMI C (1557 and 1604 MeV beams, 2013 and 2014) up to W = 1.9 GeV, fine energy and angular binning, increasing the existing pi0 photoproduction data by about 47% and sensitive to high partial waves.

title: Measurement of pi0 photoproduction on the proton at MAMI C
why_it_matters: Constrains the nucleon-resonance spectrum through partial-wave analysis of the most precisely measured meson photoproduction channel.
